citation.title: Exploring VAE-driven implicit parametric unit cells for multiscale topology optimization
citation.authors: Chenchen Chu, Alexander Leichner, Franziska Wenz, Heiko Andrä
citation.venue: Materials & Design 244 (August 2024) 113087 (Crossref); gold open access, CC BY 4.0 (Crossref licence metadata; Elsevier API core metadata: DEAL agreement)
citation.version_coded: none; only the abstract was read (pool record from OpenAlex; the DOAJ API record repeats it). The version of record could not be retrieved

claim.primary_outcome_paraphrase: Not coded (no full text). The abstract describes a VAE with a property regressor, trained on a unit-cell database built by an AAPO topology-optimization method plus a distortion filter, for multiscale thermo-mechanical metamaterial design. Efficiency is asserted, with no classical comparison named.
claim.claimed_speedup_basis: not coded (no full text); the abstract gives no time, cost or speed-up figure
